title: Brandon Aiyuk's 49ers future looks even murkier after arrest warrant issued

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aiyuk's 49ers future looks even murkier after arrest warrant issued
sources.description: A misdemeanor speeding warrant is the latest development in Brandon Aiyuk's increasingly fractured relationship with the 49ers, who appear positioned to trade or release the veteran receiver this offseason
